name: Jameson Riley
bio:
Jameson Riley's journey into motorsport began with a childhood obsession with aerodynamics, fueled by building model airplanes and poring over wind tunnel diagrams. After graduating with a degree in aerospace engineering from MIT, he honed his skills at a major aerospace firm before transitioning to Formula racing. Jameson joined Eurofarma RC ten years ago as a junior aero engineer, quickly rising through the ranks due to his meticulous approach and talent for optimizing airflow around the car. 

As Head of Aero, Jameson is known for his data-driven decision-making. He strongly believes that the best aero solutions are found through rigorous testing and simulation, and he pushes his team to explore every possible avenue for improvement. While not necessarily a visionary innovator, his strength lies in his ability to refine existing concepts and implement them flawlessly. Jameson is fiercely loyal to Eurofarma RC, viewing the team as his family.

physical.description: A stocky man with a perpetually focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
Refuses to drink anything but black coffee during race weekends.
